title: Build It and See If It Sells? That's How You Go Broke
promo_conflict: The host promotes the full episode; no product or paid offer is disclosed.

stated_problem.quote: That one sentence has burned away more weekends than any side hustle mistake that I know of.

idea.name: AI-made digital products
idea.one_liner: Create an e-book, template pack, or prompt library for buyers whose needs are validated before building; earn through direct digital-product sales.
idea.offer: An e-book, template pack, or prompt library; validate demand before creating it.
idea.revenue_model: Direct digital-product sales; price not stated.

key_quotes.quote: AI made building a digital product a ridiculously fast e-book, a template pack, a prompt library.
But, AI did not make strangers want to buy it.
People are already paying for something close to your idea.
Real evidence comes in three levels.

claims.claim: An unvalidated side-hustle product can consume six weekends and a couple hundred dollars in tools before launch.
claims.quote: Six weekends, a couple hundred bucks in tools, and then launch day and the silence is so loud that you can hear your confidence slowly leaking out from inside you.

claims.claim: AI could let someone finish a digital product by Sunday.
claims.quote: It could all be done by Sunday.

claims.claim: Testing could reveal that an idea should be dropped in a weekend rather than after six months of work.
claims.quote: You found out in a single weekend instead of after 6 months of working on it.

ideas.delivery: The creator makes and sells a downloadable e-book, template pack, or prompt library; the product and delivery platform are unspecified.
